text-entry.rationale: Kerf TextField owns supported single-line and multiline text entry after HS2-CQ1TZN.

boolean-option.rationale: Kerf Checkbox owns all boolean options after HS2-SKD293.

compact-progress.rationale: Kerf ProgressRing owns the live-claim ETA indicator after HS2-SKD293.

exceptions.rationale: Pending adoption HS2-CR912H: QuickTicketComposer still renders a raw wa-dialog and sets its ::part(dialog) viewport height and pointer events and its ::part(body) padding. Kerf DialogSurface already exposes preferred width, viewport maximum, and content layout, so this is app adoption work rather than a Kerf gap; the exception goes when HS2-CR912H moves the shell to DialogSurface.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: design: attachment-gallery__annotation-label, attachment-gallery__selected-note are tinted label and note surfaces with their own background that carry their own padding over the padded gallery stage. Upstream KF-A9H745 would let the app declare these inset surfaces instead of a per-file exception.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: design: markdown-editor__source, markdown-editor__preview are the embedded editor's source and preview panes; each supplies its own text inset inside the padded editor frame. Upstream KF-A9H745 would let the app declare these inset surfaces instead of a per-file exception.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: design: quick-ticket-composer__attachment is a tinted attachment chip that carries its own padding inside the padded attachments group. Upstream KF-A9H745 would let the app declare these inset surfaces instead of a per-file exception.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: design: workspace-chat-tile__preview-surface, workspace-chat-tile__preview-icon are the chat tile's preview surface and its tinted icon tile, each a deliberate inset surface inside the padded dashboard tile. Upstream KF-A9H745 would let the app declare these inset surfaces instead of a per-file exception.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: design: ticket-code-review__commit-sha, ticket-code-review__compare-label are tinted inline badges that carry their own padding inside the padded commit summary. Upstream KF-A9H745 would let the app declare these inset surfaces instead of a per-file exception.

Reviewed HS2-SWY32A: design: halted-session-popup__free-text is a bordered text field that supplies its own input inset inside the padded question group; it is visible and intentional in wide and phone captures. Upstream KF-A9H745 would let the app declare these inset surfaces instead of a per-file exception.
